caption:
Me asking the dumb question

The question that feels too basic to ask is usually one several people in the room are holding too.

For the colleague who nods in every meeting and looks it up later.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left. A bubble says uh, sorry... and it trembles a little. Then a bubble says what does that mean? and it leans forward. After a pause its eyes go happy with a pulse and a bubble says ohh! Then it settles back exactly where it started, so the film can repeat without a cut. The text stays: me asking the dumb question.
